Against the backdrop of the Chinese president's visit to the United States, Bloomberg News Agency reports that sensitive parts from an F-35 aircraft ended up in China's hands after the shipment was diverted to Hong Kong.

According to the report, sensitive parts from an Australian Air Force F-35 stealth aircraft, which were en route from Australia to the United States via UPS, were diverted for unclear reasons to Hong Kong and reached the Chinese authorities.

The parts in question are the cockpit canopy and the weapons bay door of the aircraft. Both components are coated with radar-absorbing material, which serves to reduce the radar signature of the F-35 and is part of its stealth capabilities.

The shipment left Australia at the end of May, passed through South Korea, and from there was diverted to Hong Kong. According to the report, the parts are still in China's possession.

The Pentagon confirmed that it is aware of the incident and stated that these are F-35 components that are not operational. According to them, the United States is working together with authorities and industry partners to recover the parts, investigate the circumstances of the incident, and prevent similar cases in the future.

item.title: [amitseg] Good evening, Amit,
item.description:
Open
Good evening, Amit,

I’m writing to you with a suffocating lump in my throat, simply because I can’t stand by and do nothing. My name is Masha Sabag, and I was the homeroom teacher of the late Michael Tyukin.

We still haven’t been able to process it. I can still see him sitting in the classroom with his sweet, shy smile—the kind that simply lit up the room.

Michael was his mother’s only child. He immigrated to Israel six years ago and fought with everything he had to serve in a combat unit. When we first met, he barely spoke Hebrew, but he already had one clear goal: to serve in the Givati Brigade. Last May, he fell at Beaufort.

All of our hearts are broken, and I know how much pain there is everywhere and how many requests you receive. But his classmates simply refuse to give up. Since his mother has no support or means to memorialize him, the students here at our youth village have taken it upon themselves to build a gym in his memory—a place that will carry on his energy and light.

They already tried reaching out to you themselves, but their message was probably lost among the many requests you receive. Their campaign has stalled, and seeing the hope fade from their eyes breaks my heart all over again.

Just one word from you, one small share, could change everything and help them reach their goal. It would bring tremendous comfort to his mother and to all of us.

Here is the link to the project:
https://giveback.co.il/project/91087

Thank you so much for listening and for caring,
Masha
